credential_manager: Stores the encrypted account key in Windows Credential Manager so the app can unlock without asking for a password.
multi_instance: Allows more than one Roblox client to run at the same time. Roblox anti-cheat behavior can change, so use this at your own risk.
kill_background_roblox: Closes idle Roblox tray processes before launching so they do not block another client.
auto_arrange_windows: Automatically places Roblox windows into the selected monitor layout after launch.
target_display: Chooses which monitor receives automatically arranged Roblox windows.
grid_layout: Chooses how arranged Roblox windows are distributed across the target display.
layout_columns: Sets the number of columns used by the fixed or custom grid layout.
layout_rows: Sets the number of rows used by the fixed or custom grid layout.
layout_dimensions: Sets the columns and rows used by a custom grid layout.
window_padding: Sets the gap, in pixels, between tiled Roblox windows and the display edges.
rename_windows: Changes Roblox window titles to include the account alias, making tiled clients easier to identify.
launch_delay: Adds a minimum pause between account launches to reduce Roblox rate limiting.
privacy_mode: Clears RobloxCookies.dat before launching to reduce account association through stored browser cookies.
anonymize_names: Replaces account names with generic labels in the app and window titles.
developer_options: Shows tools for uploading and managing Roblox developer assets.
roblox_player_path: The RobloxPlayerBeta.exe file to launch directly. Leave empty to detect the installed player automatically.
encryption_password: A master password protects the account store and is required each time RM starts. Without it, the accounts cannot be recovered.
